request.raw_text: Add 0.2 mm chamfer to the hole edges to improve fitting.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Circular rim edges of the model's through holes.
areas_to_change.location: The opening edges of the four base mounting holes and the two holes through the raised central clevis lugs, nominally at both ends of each through hole.
areas_to_change.description: Replace the selected sharp circular hole edges with narrow chamfered faces, using a 0.2 mm chamfer and the CAD system's standard equal-distance or 45-degree definition unless otherwise specified.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Hole bores, axes, and center locations
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the existing hole diameters beyond the local chamfer, through extents, axial alignment, and center spacing.
Preserve the mounting-pad profiles, recessed features, and surrounding base geometry except for the selected hole-rim edges.
Preserve lug thickness, spacing, outer profiles, and hole positions except for the local chamfers.
Preserve all ribs, sloped faces, curved transitions, pockets, exterior edges, and overall dimensions.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: Each selected hole opening has a small annular beveled face measuring 0.2 mm instead of a sharp rim.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The chamfers provide lead-ins for pins, bolts, or other mating hardware and remove sharp hole-edge interference.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: Mating components should start and align more easily during assembly while the primary hole fit and bracket structure remain effectively unchanged.

ambiguities.description: The request does not identify which of the six visible through holes require chamfering.
candidate_interpretations: Chamfer every opening edge of all four base mounting holes and both clevis-lug holes.
Chamfer only the four base mounting-hole edges.
Chamfer only the two clevis-lug hole edges used for pin fitting.

ambiguities.description: The request does not specify whether both ends of each through hole or only assembly-entry edges should be chamfered.
candidate_interpretations: Apply the chamfer to both opening edges of every selected through hole.
Apply the chamfer only to externally accessible assembly-entry edges.

ambiguities.description: Only one chamfer dimension is supplied; the chamfer angle or dimensioning method is not stated.
candidate_interpretations: Use a 0.2 mm distance chamfer with the CAD system's default angle.
